name: wotlk_80
description: For transferring characters between Wrath of the Lich King (3.3.5a) servers. Level capped at 80 to prevent importing level-hacked characters. No gold cap — WotLK endgame wealth is legitimately in the tens of thousands. Hearthstone excluded by default because different servers use different inn NPC IDs; enable it if both servers share an identical world database. Custom item templates enabled — cross-WotLK custom items can safely self-install via templateBlob. Add faction IDs to blocked_faction_ids to exclude Icecrown/Argent Tournament rep if the destination server lacks that content.
